title: Pub to pub from John o'Groats to Land's End: Gary McKee's 900-mile run for hospitality workers

posts.facebook:
900 miles in 30 days, pub to pub, for the people behind the bar. More than 83,000 others joined Gary McKee online.

Gary McKee of Cleator Moor ran about 900 miles from John o'Groats to Land's End in 30 days for the Licensed Trade Charity, with more than 83,000 people taking part online. What a national survey says volunteers get back, and how to turn your own miles into a team fundraiser.

Miles run for someone else are easier to keep going with, and easier for other people to join.

Read the full story → https://dontdieretired.com/connect/gary-mckee-jogle-pub-run/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=daily
